title: scope
description: Structured engagement context produced by the scoping skill. Other second-line skills consume this record to set institution context, persona, source posture, risk lens, and overlay set. Stable contract — additive changes only between minor versions.

engagement_id.description: Unique identifier for this engagement. Stable across revisions.

engagement_summary.description: One paragraph: what the engagement covers, why now, what is excluded.

as_of_date.description: Date the current scope was last revised.

charter.description: Charter description (e.g., national-bank charter under OCC, state-chartered member bank, Delaware corporation, Vermont captive).

registrations.description: Federal, state, FINRA, NMLS, SEC IARD, NAIC, and similar registrations.

regulator.description: Named regulator (e.g., OCC, FRB, FDIC, SEC EXAMS, SEC IM, FINRA, CFPB, NYDFS, FinCEN, OFAC, NAIC, state DOI, FCA, EBA, ECB, PRA).

recent_supervisory_posture.description: MRA, MRIA, consent order, enforcement action references where public; recent exam cycle outcomes.

sponsor.description: Accountable executive role (not a personal name).

audience.description: Roles consuming the deliverable (CRO, CCO, BSA officer, AI Risk Committee, OCC examiner-in-charge).

charter_reference.description: Engagement letter / SOW / internal charter ID.

role.description: Role running the engagement day-to-day. Backward-compatible field that downstream skills still read as 'persona.role'; semantically equivalent to 'running_lead'. On most CCO/CRO-sponsored engagements this is a delegate (e.g., a Compliance Risk Lead reporting to the CCO), not the accountable executive themselves; capture the delegate here and the executive in 'accountable_executive'.

running_lead.description: Delegate who runs the engagement day-to-day (e.g., compliance-risk-lead, model-risk-lead, TPRM-analyst-lead). Optional and additive; when not supplied, downstream consumers should default running_lead to the value of 'role' (and, if role is absent, to 'accountable_executive'). Semantically aligned with 'role' for backward compatibility; specifies the running-lead distinct from the accountable executive when the two differ. Free-text to allow lead-role variants the executive enum does not capture.

accountable_executive.description: Accountable executive who owns engagement sign-off. Optional. Same enum vocabulary as 'role'; common values include CRO, CCO, BSA-officer, AI-governance-lead, head-of-regulatory-affairs. When 'running_lead' is supplied without 'accountable_executive', downstream consumers should treat the executive as not yet named (open question for the sponsor) rather than infer one.

function.description: Plain-language function the persona sits in (risk management, model risk, AI governance, TPRM, operational resilience, compliance, financial crime, regulatory affairs, internal audit, advisory).

decision_rights.description: What the persona can sign off on within this engagement.

review_gates.description: Named gates the engagement passes through (committee review, board review, regulator review, customer-facing approval, independent challenge, partner approval, internal QC).

source_posture.description: How much non-public input the engagement is allowed to consume.

connectors_enabled.description: Specific connectors the engagement can call (GRC platform, policy management system, document management, model inventory, vendor inventory, ticketing, data-lineage).

risk_lens.description: Risk types in scope. Drives which downstream skills and overlays apply.

risk_taxonomy_reference.description: Pointer to the firm risk taxonomy this engagement aligns to (e.g., references/firm-overlay.md#taxonomy).

sector_overlay_set.description: Which sector overlays downstream skills should load.

cross_cutting_overlay_set.description: Which cross-cutting overlays downstream skills should load.

out_of_scope.description: Topics, entities, products, functions explicitly excluded.

assumptions_and_dependencies.description: Facts treated as fixed; what would invalidate them.

open_questions.description: Items the practitioner has flagged for clarification with the engagement sponsor.
